newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Medical sees antitrust period end.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Medical sees antitrust period end.

text.p: U.S. Federal Trade Commission has ended early the Hart-Scott-Rodino anti-trust waiting period it had obliged Advanced Medical Inc to obey before acquiring IVAC Medical Systems Inc, the company said Thursday.
Advanced Medical said the closing of the deal was nevertheless subject to other conditions including the completion of the financing that it needed to carry it through.
The company makes intravenous infusion pumps and proprietary disposable products.
Advanced Medical is to buy IVAC, which also makes intravenous products, for about $400 million in cash.
The acquisition will create one of the world's largest makers of intravenous infusion therapy products.
